statutory_references.night_arrest_ban: Section 46(4), Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 / Section 35(1), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
statutory_references.female_search_rule: Section 51(2), Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 / Section 49(2), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
statutory_references.legal_representation: Article 22(1), Constitution of India & Section 303 CrPC / Section 340 BNSS
statutory_references.emergency_helpline: 1091 (Women in Distress) / 112 (National Emergency Emergency Response Support System)

protective_rules.title: Strict Prohibition on Night-Time Arrest / Detention
protective_rules.rule: No woman can be arrested or detained after sunset and before sunrise, save under extraordinary circumstances with prior written permission of a Judicial Magistrate First Class.
protective_rules.citizen_instruction: If stopped at night by male officers, you have the statutory right to remain inside your locked vehicle, request the immediate presence of a female officer, and call 112.

protective_rules.title: Mandatory Female Officer for Physical Search
protective_rules.rule: Whenever it is necessary to cause a female to be searched, the search shall be made strictly by another female with strict regard to decency.
protective_rules.citizen_instruction: Male police officers or home guards are strictly forbidden from physically frisking a woman driver or passenger.

protective_rules.title: Exemption from Night Police Station Visit
protective_rules.rule: No male person under 15 years, or woman of any age, shall be required to attend at any place other than the place in which such person resides for questioning.
protective_rules.citizen_instruction: Police cannot force a woman driver to come to the police station for compounding traffic offences at night.

protective_rules.title: Right to Video Record Public Traffic Interaction
protective_rules.rule: Recording an on-duty public servant performing public duties in a public place is legal and protected, provided it does not obstruct their official duty.
protective_rules.citizen_instruction: You may keep your phone camera on or livestream the interaction for your safety.
